interpretation: A 'current-makati' classification only establishes present-day city geography, not that the park still exists or retains the same name/access/ownership.
A 'former-makati-now-taguig' classification preserves historical Makati provenance but excludes the asset from current-Makati park completeness.
The two unresolved names remain blockers until 3C-2c finds sufficiently precise location/status evidence.
Exact barangay remains intentionally blank for a few current-Makati sites where the reviewed official park source names only a street/intersection.
